confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge for a July 2026 peak-season window; no live booking pages, menus or current listings were consulted. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable, while hostel and hotel rates vary widely by neighborhood, date and booking window. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against their usual ratio to draft beer because exact local list prices vary widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used; based on general knowledge of large US coastal metro pricing (similar to San Francisco and San Diego), with a July peak-season uplift on hostel and hotel rates.

anchor_basis.beer: 16 oz domestic draft pint at a casual restaurant, about $9.50 USD
anchor_basis.coffee: 12 oz cappuccino at an independent cafe, about $5.75 USD

anchor_basis.wine_glass: house red or white by the glass at a restaurant, about $14 USD
